data.rationale: The proposal matches the true steps in order (Find a Park, Search by Activity or Topic, expand the Activity/Topic dropdown, choose options, Search) and parameterizes the category and selected options. It omits the optional state parameter, and the "check the desired option(s)" step is vague, so an automation would need guesswork on the state filter and on how to select options.
